shortDescription: Major OPEC+ nations are expected to keep oil production quotas unchanged in December, two delegates said, as conflict in the Middle East continues to curb output across parts of the group, according to Bloomberg.

title: OPEC+ Delegates Expect Oil Quotas to Remain Unchanged in December
